The '''wife''' of [[Mortimon Galli]] was reportedly killed by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] while Galli was on a fortune hunt. Galli had a [[Holopic/Legends|holopic]] of the pair of them hanging above the bar at the [[Last Stand Casino]].<ref name="Game" />
